items.title: DreamStream: Towards Policy-Oriented Generative Simulation for End-to-End Driving
items.content_html:
Lane: Simulation & evaluation (sim2real / closed-loop)
Evidence: [R]
Source: arXiv 2609.26792 · 2026-09-24
Signals: closed-loop success reported · real-robot experiments · open code or weights

Faithfully evaluating end-to-end driving policies in simulation requires observations that are not merely photo-realistic, but preserve the scene features a policy relies on to make decisions.

items.title: VLAQuantBench: Closed-Loop Evaluation of Post-Training Quantization for Vision-Language-Action Models
items.content_html:
Lane: Simulation & evaluation (sim2real / closed-loop)
Evidence: [R]
Source: arXiv 2609.25376 · 2026-09-24
Signals: closed-loop success reported · open code or weights

Post-training quantization reduces the memory requirements of vision-language-action (VLA) models, but precision selection must account for the interaction between layer scope, numerical format, and calibration.
